'''House Armaghn''' is one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Andor]] affiliated to [[House Marne]].
The only known member of the House is [[Dawlin Armaghn]]. Possibly connected to the region around the [[River Armahn]].

==Sigil==
House Armaghn's sigil is of the Oak and Axe.{{Ref/book|10|p}}

== Parallels ==
The name is similar to the county and town of [[wikipedia:Armagh|Armagh]] in present-day Northern Ireland that has historical importance.
